Visitor removes all horizontal rules

```python title="Python"

    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_horizontal_rule(self, ctx, *args):  # noqa: A002, ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = "<p>Part 1</p><hr><p>Part 2</p><hr><p>Part 3</p>"
```
